第11章 你的手怎么了（第1页）
言安希低头看着自己身上的工作服，点了点头：“哦……”
她转身就要走，慕迟曜忽然又说道：“等等。”
“啊？”她不解的看着他，“还有什么事吗？”
慕迟曜眼眸一眯，隐隐带了点危险的味道：“你的手怎么了？”
言安希没有想到他会看到自己手上的伤，下意识的回答：“被烫到了。”
“自己不小心烫的，还是别人烫到你了？”
慕迟曜修长的指尖，在桌面轻轻的敲了敲两下，声音不大，却仿佛在每个人的心上都敲响了警钟。
难道，何浅晴不顾他的警告，已经开始找言安希的麻烦了？
那么，很好，敢把他都不放在眼里了。
言安希这个时候才听出他语气里的不对劲，愣了一下，不知道要不要告诉他。
而一边的李韵，早已经吓得不敢出声了。
这么大的排场，这么强的气场，这个男人，就算她没有见过本人，但是她也知道是谁了。
他是慕天烨的大哥，慕城一手遮天，权倾商界的慕迟曜！
见言安希沉默不说话，慕迟曜微微挑了挑眉：“为什么不说？你在担心什么？”
“我给你撑腰。”他语气忽然一厉，“说！”
言安希咽了咽口水，慢慢的抬起头来，和慕迟曜深邃的目光对上。
他看了她一眼，见她久久不说话，直接把目光一转，落在她身后。
言安希小心翼翼的转头看了一眼，发现她身后不远处，站着咖啡厅里所有的员工，不知道是什么时候出来的。
慕迟曜目光沉沉，看不出任何情绪，像是一汪完全安静的水，但随时都有可能掀起滔天巨浪。
他一个个看过去，最后，把视线锁定在了李韵身上，停留了三秒，然后收回目光，朝言安希挥了挥手：“去换衣服。”
言安希点点头，一步三回头的走了，她回头看到的最后一幕，是两个人高马大的黑衣人保镖，把李韵拖了出来……
然后她就离开了，心想着快点去换衣服，看得出来，慕迟曜很不喜欢她穿这里的工作服。
言安希一走，慕迟曜浑身的气场就更加强大了，眼神瞬间冷硬无比，让人都不敢往他的方向去多看一眼，生怕殃及到自己。
“是你？”他开口，“怎么回事？”
李韵吓得浑身一哆嗦，但还是摇头否认：“不……不是我，真的不是我……”
慕迟曜声音一沉：“我不喜欢说谎的人。说谎比做错事，更让人反胃。你，明白么？”
李韵根本在他这样的气场压迫下，根本承受不了，只能老老实实的回答：“我……我不是故意的，我不小心……就，就倒在她身上了……”
慕迟曜眉尾一挑，然后哼了一声，李韵差点就要哭出来了。
慕迟曜要是打算追究这件事，那她这辈子就这么完了。
言安希是怀着忐忑的心情换回了自己的衣服，走出来的时候，看到李韵头发有些散乱，站在不远处，浑身瑟瑟发抖，两个黑衣人就站在她身边，一动不动。

Chapter 11 What happened to your hand (Page 1)
Yan Anxi looked down at her work clothes and nodded: "Oh..."
She turned around and was about to leave, when Mu Chi Yao suddenly said, "Wait a minute."
"Ah?" She looked at him puzzled, "Is there anything else?"
Mu Chi Yao narrowed his eyes, with a faint hint of danger: "What happened to your hand?"
Yan Anxi didn't expect that he would see the injury on her hand, so she subconsciously replied: "It was burned."
"Did you accidentally burn yourself, or did someone else burn you?"
Mu Chi Yao's slender fingertips tapped lightly on the table twice. The sound was not loud, but it seemed to ring an alarm bell in everyone's heart.
Could it be that He Qianqing ignored his warning and started to cause trouble for Yan Anxi?
Then, very good, I dare not even take him seriously.
Only then did Yan Anxi hear something was wrong in his tone, and was stunned for a moment, not knowing whether to tell him or not.
Li Yun on the other side was already too frightened to speak out.
With such a grand scene and such a strong aura, even if she had never seen this man in person, she knew who he was.
He is the eldest brother of Mu Tianye, Mu Chi Yao, who dominates the world with one hand and dominates the business world!
Seeing that An Xi was silent, Mu Chi Yao raised his eyebrows slightly: "Why don't you say anything? What are you worried about?"
"I'll support you." His tone suddenly became harsh, "Speak!"
Yan Anxi swallowed, slowly raised her head, and met Mu Chi Yao's deep gaze.
He glanced at her, saw that she didn't speak for a long time, and turned his gaze directly behind her.
Yan Anxi turned her head and looked carefully, and found that not far behind her, all the employees in the cafe were standing. She didn't know when they came out.
Mu Chi Yao's eyes were heavy and showed no emotion. He was like a completely quiet water, but it could set off huge waves at any time.
He looked over one by one, and finally locked his gaze on Li Yun. He stayed there for three seconds, then withdrew his gaze and waved to Yan Anxi: "Go and change clothes."
Yan Anxi nodded and walked back three times. The last scene she saw when she looked back was two tall bodyguards in black dragging Li Yun out...
Then she left, thinking about changing clothes quickly. It was obvious that Mu Chi Yao didn't like her wearing the work clothes here.
As soon as Yan Anxi left, Mu Chi Yao's aura became even stronger, and his eyes were so cold that no one dared to take another look in his direction for fear of hurting him.
"Is it you?" he asked, "What's going on?"
Li Yun was so frightened that he trembled all over, but still shook his head in denial: "No...it's not me, it's really not me..."
Mu Chi Yao's voice deepened: "I don't like people who lie. Lying is more disgusting than doing something wrong. Do you understand?"
Li Yun simply couldn't bear the pressure of his aura, so she could only answer honestly: "I...I didn't mean it, I accidentally...just fell on her..."
Mu Chi Yao raised his eyebrows, then snorted, and Li Yun almost cried.
If Mu Chi Yao plans to pursue this matter, her life will be over.
Yan Anxi changed back into her clothes with some trepidation. When she walked out, she saw Li Yun standing not far away with her hair disheveled, shivering all over. Two men in black stood motionless next to her.
